# Swing Rides

> Drive your fleet. Own your data.

Swing Rides is a modern peer-to-peer car rental marketplace and host fleet management platform across the United States. We connect vehicle owners (hosts) directly with verified drivers (renters) with 0% commission on host bookings, seamless identity verification, transparent pricing, and instant booking capabilities.

## Public Endpoints & Marketplace

- Home: https://swingrides.com/
- Browse Cars: https://swingrides.com/browse-cars
- List Your Car (For Hosts): https://swingrides.com/for-hosts
- USA Locations: https://swingrides.com/usa
- About Us: https://swingrides.com/about-us
- FAQs: https://swingrides.com/faqs
- Contact Support: https://swingrides.com/contact-support
- Report an Issue: https://swingrides.com/report-an-issue
- Connect with Host: https://swingrides.com/connect-host
- Privacy Policy: https://swingrides.com/legal/privacy-policy
- Terms and Conditions: https://swingrides.com/legal/terms-and-conditions-of-use

## Key Features & Value Proposition

- **For Renters**: Skip the rental counter, find diverse vehicles from verified local hosts, enjoy transparent pricing with no hidden fees, flexible pickup/drop-off options, and full coverage insurance protection.
- **For Hosts**: Keep 100% of your booking revenue (0% platform commission), maintain direct customer relationships, access automated fleet management, maintenance tracking, expense logs, and seamless Stripe payout processing.
